title: Code Flow Explainer
subtitle: Takes a starting point (a file and line, a function name or a plain question), traces how the work flows through the code, and explains it in plain language.
lede: Takes a starting point (a file and line, a function name or a plain question), traces how the work flows through the code, and explains it in plain language. The explanation only describes connections that actually exist in the code.
who: A product manager, new hire or executive who needs to understand how a part of the system works without reading code
author: Corey James
